scope: Calibration of a previously unfinished fixed procedure, not a new cipher family, new seed, scorer or transcription
historical_mechanical_basis: Possible transposition plus monoalphabetic substitution, discussed on Hartmeier's published2006 page https://www.benzedrine.ch/dorabella.html; unequal printed rows motivate a finite route catalogue. No historical evidence for a particular route or letter key is claimed.

No matched null calibration or full12-case sensitivity exists for that enhanced procedure. R7 calibrated a different pipeline. Current work closes that procedural gap, without claiming novelty of encryption mechanism.
family: Exactly byte-identical routes_v6.py routes():1665 unique permutations of all87 indices. Printed row lengths29,31,27; all row permutations and reversal masks with concatenate/column weave; widths2..31 with row,row-snake,column,column-snake,diagonal,diagonal-snake,spiral and4grid reflections; all coprime steps modulo87; inverses included, duplicate permutations removed in archived insertion order.
letter_key: A global injective map from the m observed glyph types into26 ASCII letters, with26-slot permutation representation including unused slots. Finite mathematical space per route is26!/(26-m)! observed assignments; only heuristic search of that space. No homophones, edits, nulls, insertions or normalization changes.

inputs.null: Exactly first19 indexed conditional controls000..018 for EACH transcription from Oct9 coordinate-lag search_inputs.json (414-case source). inputs.null_strength_limit: Global pairs/endpoints fixed; per-row pairs and row inventories not fixed. This is a conditional exploratory comparison, not every possible null model. Transcriptions are alternative readings of one object.

preflight: Verify all routes equal archived ordered1665 list, all code/model hashes,52full-length inputs, null invariants and12full-mechanism roundtrips. Run positive00 as first calibrated case and compare EVERY first/middle/final checkpoint's decoded text,key,seed,score to archived wordall; exact text/key/seed and score error<1e-9 required. A failed equivalence gate stops before any remaining real/null search; do not retune to pass.
sensitivity: Report each exact87/87 result and letter accuracy, totals exact and>=90%; no requirement12/12, no posthoc gate. Prior demonstrated objective ceiling10/12 is a known limitation, not an exclusion or reason to omit null calibration. All52cases completed irrespective of positive accuracy once technical preflight passes.
statistics: Primary descriptive statistic T=max(S_hauer,S_hart), paired-null T_i=max(S_hauer_i,S_hart_i); tail=(1+#(T_i>=T-1e-10))/20. Also each transcription separately with same rule. Report raw counts, finite resolution0.05; no multiplying tails or treating transcriptions as independent. Prespecified screening flag tail<=0.05 means0/19null pair maxima not lower; flag alone is not a decipherment. Existing repeated exploration prevents confirmatory interpretation.
acceptance_refusal: Successful calibration requires all52 complete and independently verified. No positive sensitivity threshold is imposed. A candidate must be the unchanged procedure's winner, explain all87glyphs via one listed route and injective key, and inverse-encode all87 originalglyphIDs exactly; these algebraic requirements alone never establish historical truth. Do not accept a reading on score/tail or snippets alone; coherent complete language and independent corroboration would still be required. If winner incoherent or corroboration absent, report no verified decipherment. A weak tail or poor sensitivity limits this procedure, not the whole family.
verification: Independent Python reference scoring of all final winners and finalists, injectivity and all87 inverse encodings; complete checkpoint counts; compare both newly recomputed real-case winners/route shortlists with archived wordall. Keep outcome if runtime reproducibility differs only after preflight passed and explicitly report difference; no reruns for a better score.
stop: Only these52inputs. Stop on implementation/invariant/hash/equivalence failure or resource cap. No extra seeds, hypotheses, scorer changes, manuscript correction or alternative rule after real outcomes. Preserve incomplete status if52not finished.
